question: How much time is taken by sunlight to reach Earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 min 20 sec**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The average distance from the Sun to Earth is approximately 93 million miles (150 million kilometers).
 
• Light travels at a speed of about 299,792 kilometers per second (186,282 miles per second).
 
• It takes light approximately 499.0 seconds to travel from the Sun to the Earth.
 
• This translates to about 8 minutes and 20 seconds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speed of Light:**

 
 
• Light travels at a constant speed of 299,792 kilometers per second (186,282 miles per second) in a vacuum.
 
• This speed is a fundamental constant of nature and is denoted by the letter 'c' in equations.
 
 
 
• **Astronomical Unit (AU):**
 
 
• An Astronomical Unit is a unit of length roughly equal to the distance from Earth to the Sun.
 
• 1 AU is approximately 149.6 million kilometers (93 million miles).
 
 
 
• **Light-Year:**
 
 
• A light-year is the distance that light travels in one year.
 
• It is roughly 9.46 trillion kilometers (5.88 trillion miles).
 
• Light-years are often used to measure distances between stars and galaxies.
 
 
 
• **Solar Radiation:**
 
 
• Solar radiation is the energy emitted by the Sun, including visible light, ultraviolet light, and infrared radiation.
 
• This radiation is crucial for life on Earth as it provides the energy needed for photosynthesis in plants.
